Get your Instagram QR code in the app

Instagram has a built-in code for each account. Menu labels change as the app updates.

  1. Open Instagram and go to your profile.
  2. Tap the menu (three lines) at the top right.
  3. Tap QR code. On some older Android versions it is called Nametag.
  4. Change the style if you want, then tap Share or take a screenshot.

Why use a custom code for print?

For a shop board, sticker or parcel slip, a screenshot is not enough. Small screenshots blur when enlarged and you cannot match your brand colors. A code from a generator gives you a sharp PNG or SVG, brand colors, a logo in the center and a call-to-action such as "Follow us on Instagram".

It is a static code, so there is nothing to renew and no account to log into.

How to make an Instagram QR code

You only need your username.

  1. Copy your profile link. It looks like instagram.com/yourusername.
  2. Paste it into the field above.
  3. Choose colors that match your brand, keeping the code dark on a light background.
  4. Optional: add your logo or the frame text.
  5. Download the PNG or SVG and check it by scanning from your phone.

If you change your Instagram username later, codes made from the old link will stop working, so decide your final handle before printing in bulk.

Tips for more scans

Give people a reason to scan and make the code easy to read.

  • Say why: "Scan for today's offers" works better than a bare code.
  • Keep your profile ready: a clear bio, a contact button and recent posts.
  • Size: at least about 1 inch (2.5 cm) on a bill or sticker, bigger on boards.
  • Test on two phones before printing a batch.
